site_name: FORMER WICKES AND HALFORDS, LAND OFF HAREFIELD ROAD
description: Installation of a sign case-mounted externally illuminated (trough lighting) sign (sign 1); a non-illuminated vinyl sign affixed to glazing (sign 2); a non-illuminated vinyl sign affixed to glazing (sign 3); an internally illuminated static pole-mounted sign (signs 4 and 5); a H-pole-mounted holding four internally illuminated signs (sign 6).
decision_conditions: i) No advertisement is to be displayed without the permission of the owner of the site or any other person with an interest in the site entitled to grant permission.
ii) No advertisement shall be sited or displayed so as to:
(a) Endanger persons using any highway, railway, waterway, dock, harbour or aerodrome (civil or military);
(b) Obscure, or hinder the ready interpretation of, any traffic sign, railway signal or aid to navigation by water or air or;
(c) Hinder the operation of any device used for the purpose of security or surveillance or for measuring the speed of any vehicle.
iii) Any advertisement displayed, and any site used for the display of advertisements, shall be maintained in a condition that does not impair the visual amenity of the site.
iv) Any structure or hoarding erected or used principally for the purpose of displaying advertisements shall be maintained in a condition that does not endanger the public.

REASON
To ensure the development complies with the provisions of The London Plan (2021) and Hillingdon Council's Local Plan Parts 1 (2012) and 2 (2020).

The intensity of the illumination of the advertisements shall be no greater than 300 cd/m² during hours of darkness as advised by the Institute of Lighting Professionals' publication PLG05 (2015): "The Brightness of Illuminated Advertisements", or any publication replacing or superseding this guidance.
REASON

To avoid any visual intrusion from light pollution to adjoining or nearby residents, complement the visual amenity and character of the site and surrounding area, avoid increasing road danger, and to comply with Policies HC1 and T4 of The London Plan (2021) and Policies DMHB 4, DMHB 11, DMHB 13A, DMT 2, and DMT 5 of Hillingdon Council's Local Plan: Part 2 (2020).
The externally illuminated advertisements hereby approved shall be so angled and shielded/hooded that light is directed downward onto the sign directly below.
REASON

To avoid any visual intrusion from light pollution to adjoining or nearby residents, complement the visual amenity and character of the site and surrounding area, avoid increasing road danger, and to comply with Policies HC1 and T4 of The London Plan (2021) and Policies DMHB 4, DMHB 11, DMHB 13A, DMT 2, and DMT 5 of Hillingdon Council's Local Plan: Part 2 (2020).
The externally illuminated advertisements shall be switched off between the hours of 2200 and 0800 Mondays to Saturdays and between the hours of 1700 and 0900 on Sundays.
REASON

To avoid any visual intrusion from light pollution to adjoining or nearby residents, complement the visual amenity and character of the site and surrounding area, avoid increasing road danger, and to comply with Policies HC1 and T4 of The London Plan (2021) and Policies DMHB 4, DMHB 11, DMHB 13A, DMT 2, and DMT 5 of Hillingdon Council's Local Plan: Part 2 (2020).
Prior to the display of the advertisements hereby approved, all other redundant advertisements on the premises shall be removed.
REASON
To protect the visual amenity of the area and highway safety in accordance with Policies DMHB 4, DMHB 11, DMHB 13A, DMT 2, and DMT 5 of Hillingdon Council's Local Plan: Part 2 (2020).
